Facts used:
- Lindenmoor water use: 2,151,400 cubic metres; population: 29,051.
- Kelmarsh water use: 1,739 megalitres; population: 24,117.

- 2025 has 365 days.

Calculations:

- Kelmarsh: \(1,739,000,000 \div (24,117 \times 365) = 197.553\) litres per resident per day.
- Difference: \(202.893 - 197.553 = 5.340\) litres per resident per day.

Lindenmoor households used more water per resident per day, by 5.340 litres.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 5.340
